Aa

Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Kitchen, meals & drinks

without dinner adjective

also dinnerless, supperless, not having dined, hungry to bed

classical

Plaut. Aul. 368: superī incēnātī sunt et cēnātī īnferī
Cato Agr. 156.4: cubet incēnātus (Lewis & Short)

incēnātus, incēnāta, incēnātum

declension

not having dined

(vōx cōmica: Plaut.; Cato)

The opposite of cēnātus, having dined. Ante- and post-classical (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • superī incēnātī sunt et cēnātī īnferī

    those above have had no dinner, and those below have dinedPlaut. Aul. 368

  • cupiunt extrūdere incēnātum ex aedibus

    they want to push him out of the house without his dinnerPlaut. Cas. 776

See also dinner, without lunch, fasting, be hungry.

SourcesLewis & Short: incenatus

Plautus, Aulularia 368; Casina 776.
